description_en: Creates a notification rule. You can call the CreateNotificationConfiguration operation to create a notification rule to stay informed about scaling events or resource changes. This helps you learn about the dynamic status of your scaling group in real time and further automates the management of scaling events
description_zh: 调用API CreateNotificationConfiguration创建弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知，帮助您及时掌握伸缩组的动态，进一步实现弹性伸缩事件的自动化管理
kebab_example: aliyun ess create-notification-configuration --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --notification-arn acs:mns:cn-beijing:1614568843400000:queue/modifyLifecycleHo0000 --notification-types AUTOSCALING:SCALE_OUT_SUCCESS --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNotificationConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the notification recipient. The following list describes the value formats of this parameter:

If you specify CloudMonitor as the notification recipient, specify the value in the `acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor` format.
If you specify an SMQ queue as the notification recipient, specify the value in the `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}` format.
If you specify an SMQ topic as the notification recipient, specify the value in the `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}` format.

The variables in the preceding formats have the following meanings:

`region-id`: the region ID of the scaling group.
`account-id`: the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.
`queuename`: the name of the SMQ queue.
`topicname`: the name of the SMQ topic
parameters.help_zh:
通知对象标识符，设置本参数时支持以下通知方式：

云监控，参数取值格式：`acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`。
MNS队列，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`。
MNS主题，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：
`region-id`：伸缩组所在的地域的ID。
`account-id`：阿里云账号ID。
``queuename``：MNS队列的名称。
`topicname`：MNS主题的名称
parameters.name: notification_arn

parameters.help_en:
The notification types. Specify multiple IDs in the repeated list form.

You can call the DescribeNotificationTypes operation to query the values of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
一类或者多类弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知。多个取值使用重复列表的形式。

您可以调用API DescribeNotificationTypes接口查询参数取值
parameters.name: notification_types

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The time zone of the notification. Specify the value in UTC. For example, a value of UTC+8 specifies that the time is 8 hours ahead of Coordinated Universal Time, and a value of UTC-7 specifies that the time is 7 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time
parameters.help_zh:
消息通知的时区。
时区相对于协调世界时的偏移量： 如 UTC+8（东八区）、UTC-7（西七区）等
parameters.name: time_zone

parameters.help_en:
The codec for the content of message notifications. Valid values:

PlainText: No encoding; messages are transmitted in plaintext.
Base64: Messages are encoded in Base64.

Default value: Base64.
This parameter applies only to MNS notification objects
parameters.help_zh:
消息通知内容的编码方式。取值范围：

PlainText：不编码，采用明文传输。
Base64：Base64 编码。

默认值：Base64。
仅支持MNS通知对象设置该参数
parameters.name: message_encoding
